findings.title: Wrong burning
findings.description: The function _userTransfer() does not transfer burn amount anywhere or decrease totalSupply, it just increases totalBurn value and takes burn amount from transferring amount.

findings.title: Unattached bonus rewards
findings.description: Owner can call sumTheBounsPool() function, that distributes half of the token balance in dayPoolBouns storage. Until users gain their rewards, this balance stay unaccounted.

findings.title: Abuse of authority
findings.description: Owner can call sumBounsPiece() function with very big amount and record it to dayPoolBounsPiece storage. And function _sumCanGetToken() will always revert because of too high value subtracting from dayPoolBouns[yesToday].

patch_summary: Reflected burn in balances and total supply; bounded manual bonus overrides.
